Definition: from G1537 and a derivative of the same as G160; of a sudden, i.e. unexpectedly:--suddenly. Compare G1810.
BiblicalUsage: The word exápina carries the sense of suddenly, unexpectedly. In Mark 9:8, the text says "And suddenly."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of exápina I do not force more than it gives: suddenly, unexpectedly.
